reviews.x: So pretty and not close to being as expensive as I thought they should be. I usually spend 30 bucks on mink or faux mink lashes. Love them
Amazing lashes! I got the Seattle style, and I got many compliments. They are very fluffy, soft, and they are not to clumped up and cheap looking! I will be buying again!

[[VIDEOID:d834027e3abb2bec9df57d80f1e73f97]] If you wear falsies , you know when you found good lashes! These are so gorgeous, and fluffy! They remind me of a a high end brand but these are much more of a steal because you get 5 pairs:) I got the style “Seattle”

[[VIDEOID:4818d9ce61b20a8a82d699b85ae8f3b7]] Love these lashes. Just the look I was looking for. They are super cute, lightweight  & mimic mink lashes. For the price they are so worth it. Got mines in the style Seattle. Can’t wait to wear !
These LOOK synthetic. Like a synthetic wig, the hairs have that shein to them. I got the Seattle and they’re pretty thick. I can’t imagine how dense the other styles are.

reviews.t: Not for me but good quality lashes
reviews.x: These are HUGE to me. I love glam makeup and I wear lashes all the time but even for me, these were huge. It’s all about what you like and I know plenty of people who could pull these off, but I’m not one of them! Aside from them being too big for my personal taste, they are good quality. I did wear these a 5-6 times before I decided they didn’t look good on me. They aren’t super uncomfortable. They’re a tad bit heavy on the eyes after a while but honestly all glam lashes can be so that’s to be

Eyelashes work amazing if you like long lashes with a hint of drama. They are very long and sparse when you put them on compared to what you see in the package. I thought they would be very fluffy and out there if you are like me and do not like anything to dramatic on the eye. I did cut mine on the ends just to fit my eye shape. They are not heavy (at least to me) and the product came with a note from the seller to receive a FREE pair if you like your lashes, so i am thrilled about that! Produc

reviews.t: Happy with purchase, very “stand out” type falsies
reviews.x: I just got these in the mail & as soon as I saw it I got excited. They are very beautiful very flirty type lashes. The only con is they are very flashy.. at least to me I don’t think this would be good to wear everyday , casual or work. However a night with the girls, parties, bars, date nights then definitely would be perfect. I love light weight lashes, the band is pretty thick in my personal opinion but once put on they do look gorgeous & make your eyes pop. If your looking for something supe

Love how luxurious they look!!!! Everyone always talks about how nice they look and to be honest when I saw them I thought they could easily be duped for some of these other luxurious brands that you see in Sephora or online. But I love that you get so many and you can reuse them!!

I recently bought these and i must say they’re amazing. Not only is it for a great price but the feel of these eyelashes are comfortable and beautiful!!! I wear them to work and they dont fall but stay on really strong plus i get immense compliments. Thank you Ali Crown !

I love lashes and actually really like other styles (more $) from this brand. These to me are wayyy to straight looking on, which makes them look cheap. They don’t have much curl at all to them and look weird all straight. Spend a little more $ and get better ones!

SUPER LIGHTWEIGHT! The band isn’t to thick but it is thick enough to feel like the lash isn’t just gonna come off when I had them on. To me it looked like I was wearing a pair of expensive lashes and I love the fact that I got 5 pairs for LITERALLY $8

These are my absolute favorite lashes. I struggle finding a thin banded lash that are full and long and these are perfect. Their light weight and easy to apply. I will definitely be reordering in the future. Holy grail of lashes
I honestly love these lashes. My pictures do them no justice!!! They are long but not in a way that they bother your eyes; well not for me anyway. I totally recommend them for any special occasion!!!
Hands-down these are the absolute best eyelashes I’ve ever worn.  I’ve been wearing eyelashes for 19 years but this is the first time I’ve tried faux mink; I’m super pleased that I chose this brand!
I didn't like these lashes at all. I'm surprised that so many people bought them. They were huge on my eye and I just cant imagine going out with these on. These were way too dramatic for me.
I didn't like these lashes at all. I'm surprised that so many people bought them. They were huge on my eye and I just cant imagine going out with these on. These were way too dramatic for me.
These lashes are bomb y’all. Super affordable and they last for a while as long as you take care of them. They’re also very lightweight. The band isn’t clear but it isn’t really noticeable.

reviews.t: Super flimsy and lacking dramatic affect
reviews.x: These lashes were disappointing to me. They were flimsy and difficult to apply. They band was not as thick as they appeared to be in the pictures online. Tore easily. Not dramatic enough.

reviews.t: Girl trust me, buy the Seattle lashes!
reviews.x: These are AMAZING! I purchased the Seattle ones and I’m in love! They arrived the next day! Super lightweight and full. 5 amazing unbeatable lashes. I will definitely be purchasing more!
I love this product!.. this false mink lashes are just perfect. They don't look fake and have a nice base for the glue. I highly recommend these mink lashes to anyone who are looking
I’m so extremely pleased with these lashes! They aren’t heavy or uncomfortable and the lashes are very fluffy and natural looking. I’ve gotten multiple uses out of a single pair!
These are my first pair of faux mink lashes and I really like them they manage to look a lot more fuller than how they feel. I wear them daily and they keep me lookin cute.
First of all let me just say this is the best pair of lashes I have ever purchased and  more than worth every single  penny these lashes are so soft Sexy and a must buy
I didn't care for these lashes. The bands were way too thick and not bendable at all. The lashes itself seemed nice, but I just could not stand the band. Gave it away.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the lashes as great value, noting they look expensive or high-end while being affordable and coming in multi-packs.
Many customers describe the lashes as fluffy, soft, lightweight, and comfortable to wear.
Several reviewers mention receiving compliments and find the lashes beautiful and glamorous.
Some reviewers find the lashes too large, thick, or dramatic for everyday wear, though they acknowledge the quality is good.
A few reviewers criticize the lashes for looking synthetic, cheap, or lacking curl.
